purpose: Turn the 10x staffing model into immediate executable work. Every crew receives a concrete output path, proof condition and fallback so the factory cannot remain at role-definition level.
enforcement_rules: A crew is not productive until it creates or updates its output_path.
Ready tasks must move to in_progress or blocked with fallback after the next execution cycle.
Done claims require repo proof, URL proof, QA verdict, revenue row, CFO verdict or client/revenue verification.
If public deploy is blocked, the Deploy Crew must produce a local release check and an explicit NO URL blocker with next action.
If exact public lead verification is blocked, Revenue Ops must create the verification queue and outreach pack instead of waiting.
Every active lane must end with the next single highest-value action.

work_items.proof_condition: Reusable one-day MVP shell exists for Parts Seller OS with landing, pricing, demo, lead capture and payment placeholder.
work_items.fallback: If full template cannot be built, ship static HTML shell first.

work_items.proof_condition: Reusable hero, pricing, trust, lead form, workflow and proof blocks are specified.
work_items.fallback: Ship component specification first; styled HTML components can follow.

work_items.proof_condition: Release gate can score technical, mobile, payment, trust and money clarity before done.
work_items.fallback: Use manual scorecard until automated tests exist.

work_items.proof_condition: Paid-pilot offer has lead criteria, outreach messages, follow-ups, CRM states and payment path requirements.
work_items.fallback: If exact companies are not verified yet, route to public verification queue and use outreach pack internally.

work_items.proof_condition: Paid pilot has price floor, delivery budget, break-even and continue/stop thresholds.
work_items.fallback: Use conservative manual assumptions until real pilot data exists.

work_items.fallback: If pricing is uncertain, use CFO floor and pilot discount bracket.

work_items.proof_condition: Repo has an enforcement workflow/checklist that fails missing core product-factory outputs and documents release requirements.
work_items.fallback: If GitHub Pages URL is not verified, keep NO URL blocker and local release checklist active.

next_forced_step: Run or review the Product Factory Enforcement workflow, then convert exact public lead verification into revenue rows.
